title: Bunk on Keppard and whether he preferred the Newell band
summary: Blumberg recalls nothing specific about Keppard and says he does not think Bunk was happier with the Newell band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: While we're speaking about, uh, him and Noon, it also brings the, uh, recollections of, uh, Freddie Kepard, uh, did Bunk ever speak about Freddie?

Uh, I can't recall offhand that he, uh, I know he spoke about all those people, because we were constantly asking him questions about every name that we knew of in New Orleans, and, and, uh, uh, I'm sure he couldn't be evasive all the time, and, uh, change the subject all the time. I know there are times when, uh, when he would talk, you know, uh, about these people, and, uh, but I don't remember that he said anything, uh, you know, of particular importance about them, aside from saying that, yeah, they were fine musicians, you know, and so-and-so was a fine musician, and, uh, and that kind of thing, generally.

Did you, uh, did you, uh, get the impression that, uh, that, uh, that his band, uh, this, uh, this, uh, band with Don Newell, uh, did you get the impression that he was happier with this band than he was with, uh, George, uh?
